invitation.title: Defence Family Support Survey
paragraphs: Lutheran Care wants to understand the real needs of Defence personnel and families who live or work in Greater Darwin, or have a posting connected with this area.
The questions cover difficulties, help that was needed or received, support that has worked, and what may be needed next. You can mention needs beyond Lutheran Care’s own services.
Your answers would help plan support and connections; this preview does not sign you up for anything.
invitation.funding: Lutheran Care received funding from Defence Member and Family Support, a branch of the Commonwealth Department of Defence, to deliver this project.

notice: Trying this preview is voluntary. Most questions are optional.

This preview does not send or save your answers. They remain in this browser page until you close or reload it. Please leave out names, addresses, service numbers and other identifying details. The separate contact form does not receive your survey answers.

If Lutheran Care later opens a live survey, it will explain how answers are collected, stored, used to plan the Defence Family Support Program and shared with Defence. A live survey would require its own collection and privacy arrangements.
There is no submission in this preview. You can stop and clear your answers at any time.
Contact feedback@lutherancare.org.au. Our Privacy Policy explains your rights, including access, correction and complaints.
This survey is not a request for services. In an emergency in Australia, call 000. For domestic, family or sexual violence support, contact 1800RESPECT on 1800 737 732.
